description: Bring the latest main into your worktree (rebase, sync, pull what merged): Agenium commits your changes on your branch and rebases it on main, since git commit, stash and rebase cannot run in the sandbox. Use it when a ticket you depend on merged or you are told to rebase. On a conflict nothing changes and the files are listed: read main's version (git show main:<file>), bring its change into your file, then call again with keep_mine=true.
title: update_from_main
